## Requirement

<a id="Refund"></a>

### Refund on cancellation

`Refund` · `src/cancellation.ts:85` · status: **held** · published

The amount returned to the driver when they cancel their reservation.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ period, fee }) => (r: Reservation, leadTime: Duration): CHF =>
    leadTime >= period[r.charger] ? r.price : r.price - r.price * fee
```

</details>

- Owner: lea
- Parameters: `period` ← [Free cancellation period](#FreeCancellationPeriod) · `fee` ← [Late cancellation fee](#LateFee)
- Refines: [Cancel without stress](#CancelWithoutStress)
- Assumes: [Idempotent payment provider](#IdempotentProvider)
- Served by: [Cancel a reservation](api.md#CancelReservation), [End of free cancellation](api.md#FreeCancellationEnd)
- Used by: [Cancel a reservation](api.md#CancelReservation), [Every reservation is refunded according to the rule](scenarios.md#ComplianceScenario), [Cancelling twice refunds only once](scenarios.md#RepeatedCancellationScenario)
- Constrained by: [Immediate refund](#ImmediateRefund), [A day ahead, a full refund](consumer.md#FullRefundAhead)
- Amended by (not in force): [Launch of the ultra chargers](committee.md#UltraLaunch)
- Verified by: [Every reservation is refunded according to the rule](scenarios.md#ComplianceScenario)

<a id="RefundCriteria"></a>

**Refund criteria · owner: lea**

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Cancelling two hours ahead costs nothing | passed |
| Exactly at the end of the free period, the driver is refunded | passed |
| Four minutes ahead, the driver pays the late fee | passed |
| On a fast charger, six minutes ahead is enough | passed |
| On an ultra charger, fifteen minutes ahead is enough | passed |
| The refund is never more than the price paid | passed |

## Decisions

<a id="FreeCancellationPeriod"></a>

### Free cancellation period

`FreeCancellationPeriod` · `src/cancellation.ts:56` · published

Up to this long before the slot starts, cancelling costs nothing.

| ChargerType | Value |
|---|---|
| fast | 5 min |
| normal | 10 min |
| ultra | 15 min · amended by [Period for ultra chargers](committee.md#UltraPeriod) |

- Allowed range: from 5 min to 20 min

> Overlap on `value.ultra` of [Free cancellation period](#FreeCancellationPeriod), between [Period for ultra chargers](committee.md#UltraPeriod) and [Ultra period requested by support](support.md#SupportUltraPeriod): [Period for ultra chargers](committee.md#UltraPeriod) prevails (approved by lea, owner of "Free cancellation period"; see [Approval of the ultra period](committee.md#UltraPeriodApproval)).

- Decided by: lea
- Review planned: March 2027
- Rejected: 30 min, blocks the chargers at peak hours
- Used by: [End of free cancellation](api.md#FreeCancellationEnd), [Refund on cancellation](#Refund), [Read a reservation](scenarios.md#ReadScenario)
- Amended by: [Period for ultra chargers](committee.md#UltraPeriod), [Ultra period requested by support](support.md#SupportUltraPeriod)
- Used by: [Refund criteria](#RefundCriteria)

<a id="LateFee"></a>

### Late cancellation fee

`LateFee` · `src/cancellation.ts:68` · published

The share of the price that is kept when the driver cancels after the free period.

- Value: 50%

- Decided by: lea
- Rejected: 100%, perceived as punitive
- Capped by: [Legal cap on cancellation fees](legal.md#FeeCap)
- Used by: [Refund on cancellation](#Refund)

## Quantity

<a id="SwissFrancs"></a>

### Swiss francs

`SwissFrancs` · `src/cancellation.ts:36`

The currency of the prices and of the refunds: an amount of one currency never adds up with another.

Source: ISO 4217, Codes for the representation of currencies: CHF · `https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html`

| Unit | Of the base unit |
|---|---|
| `chf` | 1 |

- Owner: karim
- Written with: [How an amount is written](#AmountWords)
